descriptions.text: Yapizon, a South Korean Bitcoin exchange, announced last week it lost 3831 Bitcoin (over $5.5 million) after an unknown hacker breached its system and stole funds from its server.

Yapizon, a South Korean Bitcoin exchange, was breached on April 22, 2017 when attackers gained access to the private keys for four hot wallets, resulting in a theft of about 3,816 BTC (≈$4.8M at the time). The loss forced the exchange to reduce all user balances by 37% and issue IOU tokens, with no funds ever recovered. Attackers compromised the private keys to Yapizon's operational hot wallets, enabling unauthorized withdrawal of all assets held in those wallets.
